metadata.skill_name: Trace Metadata Update with Error Handling
metadata.objective: Update trace metadata and return success status

skill_drafts.name: Trace Metadata Update with Error Handling
skill_drafts.description: Safely update trace metadata with exception logging and boolean status return. Invoked when modifying trace attributes during agent execution and the caller needs explicit success or failure feedback.
skill_drafts.objective: Update trace metadata and return success status
contraindications: Trace is already closed or finalized
Bulk metadata operations without retry logic
workflow_steps: Receive metadata update request with target trace and attribute(s)
On exception: log error with logger.error() and return False
triggers: Trace metadata (tags, status, custom fields) needs modification during active session
Caller requires explicit success/failure feedback on metadata update
constraints: Must wrap update in try-except block
Must log exception before returning False
cautions: Exception logging should include full error context for debugging
Caller should not assume False return means trace is corrupted; only metadata update failed
Do not use for transactional metadata updates requiring rollback
output_contract: Boolean return value: True if metadata updated successfully; False if exception occurred and was logged. Caller uses return value to decide whether to retry, escalate, or continue.

metadata.prompt: Attempt to update trace metadata (e.g., tags, status, custom fields). Wrap the update operation in a try-except block. On success, return True. On exception, log the error and return False. Do not suppress the exception; log it for debugging.
